name: Brooks Molds
old_description: Welcome to Brooks Molds. We specialize in the tooling and manufacturing of molds for the cast polymer industry, including cultured marble, Tyvarian and solid surface molds. For over 20 years, we’ve been making molds that are unmatched in performance and unrivaled in craftsmanship, skillfully built with our hands just as much as with our hearts and our minds.  Our cast polymer fiberglass molds are built with quality materials and durable bracing systems, and we made our name producing durable standard and custom molds with industry-leading design and construction. We exceptionally specialize in customizing solutions for your unique mold needs. We will exceed your expectations, and you can count on peace of mind, productivity and innovation when you use our molds.
about:
Brooks Molds is based in Elmore, Alabama. Founded in 1999 as a family-owned and operated business by Bobby Brooks, who began his career in the composites industry in 1984 at Mortar Creek Plastics in Elmore, rising to shop supervisor and master pattern maker before launching his own company. His son Timothy now works alongside him.

The company specializes in the tooling and manufacturing of molds for the cast polymer industry, including cultured marble, Tyvarian, and solid surface applications. Using hand layup techniques, they produce both standard and custom molds—bowls, wall panels, vanity tops, shower pans, shower niches, trim molds, and other custom designs. Each mold is built with fiberglass and heavy-duty bracing systems, and every step is monitored by the owners to ensure durability.

Brooks Molds serves cast polymer manufacturers across the United States. Customers include Majestic Kitchen & Bath, Micalline LLC, Amarillo Marble, Elite Marble, The Bath Collection, Carstin Brands, Easton Industries, Custom Bath Products, St. Louis Marble Company, Custom Designer Surface, Hall Marble, and BSWB Inc. These clients rely on the molds for daily production of cultured marble and solid surface products.

The company emphasizes skill and durability as differentiators, citing over 20 years in the cast polymer mold business, immaculate care of permanent master patterns, and the ability to handle both standard and custom design challenges. Their heavy-duty bracing systems are designed to reduce downtime from mold repairs, and they claim their molds last for years under heavy use.
